checks.name: Accepting a claim returns while the live catalog is held
A duplicate start cannot overwrite the accepted claim
The accepted claim becomes ready after the model owner releases
Only the durable claim returns the canonical action
The successful claim disarms the live action
The disarm is present in the reopened durable catalog
A repeated claim has no action and adds no redundant checkpoint
An accepted foreign decision retains priority over the new claim
The claim resumes when the foreign decision is acknowledged
A newly pending scanner prevents a stale claim without disarming it
A checkpoint failure returns no executable action
Checkpoint failure restores the armed live job and exact durable catalog
The exact failed claim can be explicitly retried once
Preparation failure preserves the armed action for retry
Result publication releases the model and survives a failed notification
Independent competing claim owners both settle
Concurrent claims produce at most one executable action
Owner shutdown joins its accepted claim instead of detaching or dropping it
A removed or absent target cannot produce an action
Repeated owner cleanup is safe
